style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2, modern everyday setting, original people in present-day casual clothes. NO text, letters, numerals, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Communicate the specific meaning through clear actions and relationships, suitable for elementary-school readers and mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass greens, pale sky blues, warm earthy browns, plenty of ivory breathing room. No flat digital color blocks, no glossy shading, no 3D, no imitation of any named artist. Scene:
scene_prompt: A modern community gardener effortlessly removes a rotten low garden fence. Adult in plain work clothes and gloves gently pushes a rail with one hand; severely decayed brown rails crumble and fall apart in sequence with almost no force. Clear brittle powdery broken ends, collapsed lightweight fragments on the ground, a second rotten rail already sagging. The gardener is relaxed and upright, no strain, no tools or heavy machinery, while a second adult watches from safely to the side. Beyond the fence are garden beds. Emphasize overwhelming ease of overcoming a weak decaying obstacle, not strength against sound timber. Grounded legs, natural gloved hands attached to wrists, rail precisely touching the pushing palm, gravity pulls fragments downward, coherent fence posts in soil. Suitable for children, no injuries. 3:2 landscape, restrained pencil-watercolor on ivory paper, no readable text brands logos or watermarks.
alt: 園丁輕輕一推，腐朽的矮木柵欄便接連碎裂倒下，他神情輕鬆，同伴在旁觀看。
